args.title: Fix weekly scheduled export first run date calculation
args.body:
File: src/export/scheduler.ts

Fix the weekly export cadence calculation in `nextRunAt` so that when a weekly schedule is created on its scheduled day before the run hour, the first run occurs on the same day instead of being pushed out a full week.
